🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive, a narrow/weak reading; VXX is ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.00% | 1M: +21.23%) and SPY is BELOW TREND (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -7.40%) while TLT is ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +0.56%). Falling stocks-versus-bonds and credit ratios provide further confirmation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is rising: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.00% | 1M: +21.23%). Credit stress is rising near term: HYG/LQD at 0.7424 (1W: -0.79%, ↓ falling | 1M: +0.55%, ↑ rising; CORRECTION); HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -0.07%) versus LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +0.26%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar firm: UUP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +2.46%), ↑ rising. Yield-curve ratio is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.96%, ↑ rising | 1M: -1.42%, ↓ falling); this indicates a weekly bounce, not a sustained monthly turn.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Broad sector selling: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.53% | 1M: -14.77%) and XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -10.67%). Defensive ETFs also fell this week: XLP CORRECTION (1W: -1.32% | 1M: +3.16%) and XLU CORRECTION (1W: -1.83% | 1M: +2.40%); breadth does not confirm a style leader, so style is mixed.

5. US vs Global?
US and emerging markets are weak: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -7.40%) versus EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -10.73%). China also lags on the week: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.05% | 1M: -3.49%); India is more resilient but in CORRECTION: INDA (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +7.70%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation is under pressure: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -9.44% | 1M: -14.82%) and IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -4.43%). Crypto weakness is more pronounced: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -16.29% | 1M: -24.30%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial commodities are weak: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -9.34% | 1M: -14.62%). Gold is also BELOW TREND (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -11.55%); the copper/gold ratio is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.99%, ↓ falling | 1M: -3.39%, ↓ falling), signaling cyclical softness.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy ETFs remain BELOW TREND: XLE (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -10.67%) and BNO (1W: -3.56% | 1M: -12.24%). Natural gas is in CORRECTION: UNG (1W: -1.91% | 1M: +2.91%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED weakness: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -7.40%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.53% | 1M: -14.77%); TLT is ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +0.56%). The HYG/LQD ratio is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.79%, ↓ falling | 1M: +0.55%, ↑ rising), a near-term credit-stress divergence against its monthly trend.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Risk-off posture remains supported by weak breadth, rising fear, and bonds outperforming stocks. Favor relative resilience in TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +0.56%); reduce exposure to speculative risk while style leadership remains unconfirmed.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves and weekly momentum turns positive, monitor XLP, currently in CORRECTION (1W: -1.32% | 1M: +3.16%). BEARISH: If selling persists, monitor XLK, BELOW TREND (1W: -7.53% | 1M: -14.77%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the copper/gold ratio stops falling, monitor CPER, currently BELOW TREND (1W: -9.34% | 1M: -14.62%). BEARISH: If energy weakness continues, monitor BNO, BELOW TREND (1W: -3.56% | 1M: -12.24%).

13. Key Levels?
Reference points: SPY/TLT 8.9094 (1W: -6.25%, ↓ falling | 1M: -5.07%, ↓ falling; BELOW TREND) and HYG/LQD 0.7424 (1W: -0.79%, ↓ falling | 1M: +0.55%, ↑ rising; CORRECTION). Also watch XLK/XLF 2.8911 (1W: -0.37%, ↓ falling | 1M: -10.18%, ↓ falling; BELOW TREND) and copper/gold 0.1007 (1W: -1.99%, ↓ falling | 1M: -3.39%, ↓ falling; BELOW TREND).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive, a narrow/weak reading. Long-duration Treasuries show relative strength, while equity sector breadth confirms no clear style leader. Monitor rising fear in VXX, ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.00% | 1M: +21.23%), and the falling weekly HYG/LQD ratio for further stress.
